description: This source file implements an HTTP client role within the libwebsockets library, handling HTTP request/response lifecycle, SSL/TLS and protocol upgrades, redirect handling, and multipart form data composition, primarily for use as a client-side component.

methods.name: void lws_client_http_body_pending(struct lws * wsi,int something_left_to_send)
methods.description: Sets the flag indicating whether there is pending HTTP request body data to send.

methods.name: int lws_http_client_socket_service(struct lws * wsi,struct lws_pollfd * pollfd)
methods.description: Core function that manages socket events for the HTTP client, handling different connection states, SSL/TLS negotiation, proxy handling, HTTP handshake, response parsing, redirects, and data transfer.

methods.name: int LWS_WARN_UNUSED_RESULT lws_http_transaction_completed_client(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Handles post-transaction processes once an HTTP request completes, resetting state, invoking callbacks, and preparing for potential new transactions.

methods.name: lws_http_client_interpret_server_handshake
methods.description: Processes the server's HTTP response headers, manages redirects, connection headers, Content-Length, Chunked transfer-encoding, and transitions connection states accordingly.

methods.name: int lws_http_is_redirected_to_get(struct lws * wsi)
methods.description: Checks if the current transaction was redirected to a GET method.

methods.name: uint8_t * lws_http_multipart_headers(struct lws * wsi,uint8_t * p)
methods.description: Prepares the multipart form data headers with a unique boundary for HTTP POST requests.

methods.name: int lws_client_http_multipart(struct lws * wsi,const char * name,const char * filename,const char * content_type,char ** p,char * end)
methods.description: Appends multipart form-data boundary and associated headers to the outgoing request body.

methods.name: char * lws_generate_client_handshake(struct lws * wsi,char * pkt)
methods.description: Generates the initial WebSocket or HTTP request headers for client handshake, including optional WebSocket upgrade headers.

methods.name: struct:lws * lws_client_reset(struct lws ** pwsi,int ssl,const char * address,int port,const char * path,const char * host,char weak)
methods.description: Performs a reset of the client connection for redirect purposes, creating a new connection context with updated parameters.

methods.name: int lws_http_basic_auth_gen(const char * user,const char * pw,char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Generates Base64-encoded Basic Authentication header from username and password.

methods.name: lws_client_read
methods.description: Reads data from the server, handling chunked transfer decoding, content length, buffering, and invoking protocol callbacks.

methods.name: int lws_http_client_read(struct lws * wsi,char ** buf,int * len)
